material.goal: Determine the exact evidence-supported cause of the SWU-OEWSN-006 focused typed-test failure and explain why the failed attempt retained only TYPED_TESTS_FAILED instead of actionable diagnostics. Produce an exact owner map for the smallest candidate repair and reusable prevention changes in code, tests, admission contracts, or skills without implementing or retrying the build.
material.context: Attempt 20260803T175337Z passed producer material validation, fresh consumer admission, byte parity, and all 21 generalized-builder contract tests, then consumed its single authorized immutable-lockfile build attempt and stopped at TYPED_TESTS_FAILED. The builder retained no typed-test output, failed workspace, build handle, dashboard, patch snapshot, or browser evidence, so the terminal receipt proves the gate failed but not which assertion or type error caused it. Candidate binding006 and patch0004 remain live, SWU006 remains selected, SWU007 remains stopped, and this research must preserve that boundary while distinguishing product/test defects from diagnostic-lifecycle and governance defects.
material.anti_bias_global: candidate defect versus diagnostic-lifecycle defect versus governing-contract defect

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 runs computational and static reconstruction on the SWU006 candidate bytes while agent 1 runs historical systems tracing over the builder and session lifecycle on the methodology and source-corpus axes; a patch-centric bias in agent 0 would be exposed by agent 1's evidence-loss chronology, while a process-centric bias in agent 1 would be exposed by agent 0's exact code and test contradiction.

Agent 0 tests the candidate patch and typed-test contract while agent 2 derives formal failure-evidence and owner contracts on the methodology axis; a local-defect bias in agent 0 would be exposed by agent 2's reusable invariant analysis, while an idealized-contract bias in agent 2 would be exposed by agent 0's concrete SWU006 witness.

Agent 1 traces when diagnostics disappeared across runtime and closeout artifacts while agent 2 compares code, Task Session, observer, and maintenance owner obligations on the source-corpus and methodology axes; a chronology-only bias in agent 1 would be exposed by agent 2's necessity and ownership test, while an over-broad governance bias in agent 2 would be exposed by agent 1's exact causal sequence.

agents.angle: computational and static reconstruction of binding006, patch0004, generated postimages, typed-test selection, and the first exact failing condition
agents.initial_prompt: Work read-only and without network access. Reconstruct the SWU-OEWSN-006 candidate from the immutable binding and patch chain using existing retained sources or disposable non-repository scratch only; do not invoke the generalized build or dependency installation. Inspect binding006, patch0004, predecessor binding005 and patch0003, build-thin-prototype.mjs, thin-prototype-build.test.mjs, the seven focused typed test files or their patch postimages, and any retained SWU005 source snapshot. Return: exact candidate/test contradictions; the narrowest provable failure cause or ranked hypotheses when the missing diagnostic prevents proof; a command-and-file execution path; exact paths plus functions, hunks, JSON Pointers, test names, and hashes; and a minimal no-network reproduction or static witness. Inventory lead: prior OEW rebuild research says reproducibility guards and direct typed failures must be separated; re-verify sources. Do not edit product, planning, skills, Inventory, telemetry, Git, or external state, and do not claim the exact assertion if the evidence cannot prove it.

agents.angle: historical systems chronology of command capture, cleanup, receipt emission, authorization consumption, and the point where actionable failure evidence was discarded
agents.initial_prompt: Work read-only and without network access. Trace the complete SWU006 attempt from Task Session admission through builder command execution, error mapping, temporary-workspace cleanup, terminal receipt, Invoke closeout, continuity state, and signal-observer output. Compare the current builder and Task Session contracts with the previous successful SWU005 build and the generalized-builder evolution evidence. Produce a causal timeline and evidence-retention matrix: stage, owner, evidence available in process, evidence persisted, cleanup action, downstream receipt, first moment of irreversible information loss, and whether that behavior is intentional or an uncovered gap. Use exact paths, functions, JSON Pointers, receipts, and hashes. Inventory leads: Invoke one-shot research preserves empirical command-failure residue and the current observer names a diagnostic-retention gap; verify both against direct sources. Do not retry, fetch, edit, or infer the product root cause from the generic error alone.

agents.angle: formal prevention contract and owner allocation across the OEW builder, its tests, Work Pack admission, Task Session, Task Session Until Blocker, signal observer, and sigil maintenance
agents.initial_prompt: Work read-only and without network access. From the exact SWU006 counterexample, derive the smallest reusable contract that lets one-attempt acceptance failures remain fail-closed while retaining enough bounded evidence to diagnose them. Compare candidate owners: OEW builder code and tests; semantic-navigation planning and mutation-admission outputs; Task Session receipt requirements; Task Session Until Blocker coordination; signal-observer recommendations; and sigil-maintenance routing. For each candidate change, state necessity, scope, exact owning source, proposed receipt fields or artifact, cleanup/privacy/security constraints, positive fixture, single-fault negative fixture, and whether it is SWU006-specific or reusable. Preserve immutable-lockfile, credential, no-unrelated-network, candidate-local, public/private, and no-implicit-retry boundaries. Inventory lead: the pre-Task-Session strategy provides a partition precedent only; do not import its conclusion. Return an exact change map, not edits, and distinguish builder implementation defects from capability/skill contract defects.

Reconcile the three explorer returns into an exact-binding diagnosis and prevention map. Lead with a plain-language answer that separates what is proved, what is a ranked hypothesis because diagnostics were destroyed, and what can be prevented regardless of the product root cause. Produce: the attempted execution path; candidate/test contradiction matrix; exact root-cause verdict or honest unresolved rows; diagnostic-loss chronology; owner-by-owner change map for builder code, tests, planning/admission, Task Session, Until Blocker, observer, and maintenance skills; minimal failure-evidence schema; no-network fixtures; security and cleanup constraints; adoption order; and explicit decisions on which code or skill should and should not change. Cite every load-bearing row to explorer returns and exact selectors. Do not prescribe a generalized-build retry or implementation under this research authority.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 attacks precedent and existing ownership while agent 1 attacks non-vacuity on the attack-vector axis; an owner label without a diagnostic-preservation witness would be exposed by agent 1, while a new fixture or mechanism duplicating an existing owner would be exposed by agent 0.

Agent 0 tests whether each prevention is already owned while agent 2 tests definitional and capability collapse on the attack-vector axis; a build-from-owned proposal that renames another capability would be exposed by agent 2, while a collapse claim that ignores a distinct existing owner would be exposed by agent 0.

Agent 1 requires a concrete failed-test evidence fixture while agent 2 attacks semantic overreach across failure, blocker, residue, retry, and completion states on the attack-vector axis; a mechanically effective but overloaded contract would be exposed by agent 2, while a clean taxonomy with no actionable witness would be exposed by agent 1.

agents.angle: precedent gate over current builder, Task Session, observer, maintenance, and prior OEW evidence owners
agents.initial_prompt: Attack only the precedent gate. Verify every proposed correction and prevention against current repository owners, prior accepted OEW research, builder failure contracts, Task Session receipt rules, signal-observer output, and sigil-maintenance ownership. Label candidates already-deployed, build-from-owned, or precedent-clean; precedent never emits KILL. Reject any new skill or capability when the evidence shows that an existing owner only lacks a field, failure branch, fixture, or maintenance handoff. Cite exact source paths and selectors, and treat Inventory only as a lead.

agents.angle: non-vacuity gate requiring a no-network typed-test failure witness with retained actionable diagnostics and bounded cleanup
agents.initial_prompt: Attack only non-vacuity. Require the smallest deterministic fixture in which a focused typed test fails, the builder still returns a typed blocker, actionable stdout/stderr and command identity are persisted inside an admitted bounded artifact, secrets and unrelated environment are excluded, temporary source cleanup remains fail-closed, and no retry occurs. Require a passing control and single-fault negatives for missing diagnostics, unbounded workspace retention, secret leakage, output-path escape, and false success. KILL any candidate that merely renames TYPED_TESTS_FAILED, keeps only a generic message, weakens cleanup, or depends on another network attempt to explain the first failure.

agents.angle: definitional-soundness gate separating product defect, test defect, diagnostic loss, authorization consumption, blocker state, observer signal, and maintenance authority
agents.initial_prompt: Attack only definitional soundness. Test whether the synthesis collapses the candidate product bug with missing diagnostic evidence, treats a failed acceptance gate as a governance failure, treats observer recommendation as mutation authority, or makes Task Session own builder-specific implementation. Require precise meanings for test failure, failure evidence, retained artifact, failed workspace, authorization consumed, retry authorized, blocker opened, maintenance candidate, and SWU completion. KILL tautological, re-skinned, or owner-collapsing proposals and preserve the public/private boundary for any reusable Arcanum recommendation.

After exact-binding evidence closure is ready, write findings.md only. Lead with the direct answer: exact root cause if proved, otherwise the narrowest evidence-supported hypotheses and the independently proved diagnostic-retention cause. Document the execution path, candidate/test matrix, diagnostic-loss chronology, candidate verdict matrix, exact owner-by-owner code/test/contract/skill changes, failure-evidence schema, no-network fixture suite, privacy and cleanup constraints, rejected alternatives, adoption order, unresolved residue, and one bounded later implementation route. Cite every load-bearing claim and do not authorize a build retry, implement changes, or claim SWU006 completion.

Audit findings.md only against the dispatch goal and exact-binding contract. APPROVE only if it distinguishes proved root cause from hypotheses; accounts for binding006, patch0004, the seven-file fifteen-test contract, the generic TYPED_TESTS_FAILED mapping, cleanup, consumed authorization, terminal receipt, closeout, and observer; identifies exact code, test, planning, Task Session, observer, or skill owners without collapse; provides a no-network failure-evidence witness and security constraints; preserves fail-closed behavior, no implicit retry, SWU007 stop, and public/private boundaries; and recommends one bounded later route. Otherwise request one bounded writer revision. Approval is research acceptance only.
